signature: dm(z) = -7.5 eps log10(1+z); unabsorbable by ladder normalization (z-shape, not offset)
eps_allowed_range: eps <= ~0.05-0.10: the binding point is the high-z end of the calibrated SN baseline (eps <= 0.04-0.07 at z=1; 0.08-0.11 at z=0.5)
eps_excluded_by_SN: eps = 1 predicts -2.26 mag at z=1, ~15-23x the residual floor: full k-mouflage interior tracking is falsified by the SN ladder
verdict: SN residuals bound the interior tracking fraction to eps <= ~0.05-0.10 — far below the eps=2/3 neutralization and the eps=1 flip. The siren discriminant survives at near-naive strength: M_det ~ (1+z)^{-0.70..-0.85} vs GR's (1+z), separation ~(1+z)^{1.7-1.85}. Interiors are effectively pinned against the ambient drift over the SN baseline; deriving the small residual eps from the interior solution (local well depth vs ambient drift, plus shallower early wells) is the remaining item, shared with the compact-star solver.
